label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is alert-FP because encodeForHTML(sql) sanitizes the user-controlled 'sql' string before HTML output, neutralizing XSS risks. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection) is alert-TP because the 'sql' variable is constructed via string concatenation with user input ('bar') and passed directly to JDBC batchUpdate without parameterization, creating a genuine SQL injection vulnerability.

evidence.note: XSS sink shows encodeForHTML(sql) applied to user-controlled data, mitigating XSS
SQL injection sink shows direct concatenation of user input into SQL query string
